product.name: REVERSIBLE Custom Ink Full-Dye Football Uniforms
product.description: Custom Ink football uniforms use high quality fabric that is fully sublimated to give you a great fit and feel with bold and vibrant colors that won't wear off. Custom Ink football uniforms have everything from classic looks to more cutting edge designs to ensure your team looks the best on the field. Orders having less than 10 garments are subject to a minimum order fee of $25. *Please note that seam stitching in the primary color of the jersey is visible when the jersey is reversed
product.leadTime: Mockup Lead Time: 2-4 business days after order is placed. Ships: 2 weeks after artwork approval.

styles.description: Details: Galaxy Knit fabric | 100% polyester | Double ply | Reversible | 8.8 oz | V-neck collar | Short sleeves | Custom logo on wearer’s right chest | Sublimated design | Athletic fit | Jock tag on bottom hem | Made in Dominican Republic | Imported | Fabric made in US

designs.name: Design 1000
designs.description: Designs are sublimated to provide bold, vibrant colors that won't wear off. Note: When darker colors (i.e. black) are paired with lighter colors (i.e. white), the darker side numbers may slightly show through on the lighter side. Seam stitching in the primary color of the jersey is visible when the jersey is reversed. Details: Turf Tech Prime | 87% Polyester / 13% Spandex | 11 oz. | Raglan Sleeve | Stretch Side Panels | Stretch yoke for added durability | Elastic sleeve cuffs | Sublimated Jock Tag | Fitted | Imported | Fabric made in the USA
